description: FileStockForm rendered alone lists the locations already on record from the real GET /api/locations in the field-location combobox listbox
FileStockForm field-location offers a 'Use new location' option when the typed location matches none on record
FileStockForm renders file-confirmation with the not-tracked indicator after submitting without a tracking_code against the real API
FileStockForm renders file-confirmation showing the submitted tracking_code after a submit that gave one against the real API
FileStockForm renders an inline form-error naming the quantity field when the real API rejects a negative quantity
StockLookup renders lookup-result with the filed sku, location, quantity and tracking_code for a record that exists in the real backend
StockLookup renders the lookup-not-tracked indicator when the retrieved record has a null tracking_code
StockLookup renders lookup-empty when the real API returns 404 for a (sku, location) with no record
